title: CNPOS Scene Contract v1_2
description: Deterministic scene-level contract for CNPOS v1_2 cinematic pipelines.

domain.description: Fixed domain identifier for scene-level payloads.

version.description: Contract version; must match CNPOS v1_2.

scene_id.description: Deterministic scene identifier (UUID or canonical string).

episode_id.description: Identifier of the episode this scene belongs to.

index.description: Zero-based index of the scene within the episode.

summary.description: Short description of the scene content.

beats.description: Ordered list of narrative beats within the scene.

index.description: Zero-based index of the beat within the scene.

emotional_tone.description: Optional emotional tone annotation for the beat.

role.description: Role in the scene (protagonist, antagonist, supporting, etc.).

arc_state.description: Optional arc state label for continuity tracking.

shots.description: Ordered list of shot descriptors associated with this scene.

index.description: Zero-based index of the shot within the scene.

description.description: Short description of the shot content.

metadata.description: Auxiliary metadata for orchestration and telemetry.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the scene payload.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp of the scene payload.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline instance that produced/modified this payload.

orchestrator_id.description: Identifier of the orchestrator managing this scene.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the governance policy applied to this scene.

flags.description: List of governance flags (e.g., content warnings, constraints).
